description: "The Diary of Samuel Pepys" by Samuel Pepys is a historical account written during the mid-17th century. The work revolves around the detailed and personal diary entries of Samuel Pepys, chronicling a decade of significant historical events, including the Restoration of the monarchy, the Great Plague, and the Great Fire of London, while also providing insight into the social and political life of the time through Pepys's unique perspective.
